description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans grain call filters (interceptors), including system-wide, grain-specific, incoming and outgoing filters, as well as tests for filter execution order, exception handling, dependency injection, and extension method interception. It also defines related interfaces and classes used in the tests.

classes.name: IMyRegularInterface
classes.description: Interface with alias attributes for setting and getting extension values.

classes.name: IMyOtherInterface
classes.description: Another interface with alias attributes for extension value manipulation.

classes.name: MyGrainExtension
